text:
mia: quick sync — planning to ship 'model library v1' in ~2 weeks (target 2026-06-01). Need clear ownership, licensing sign-off, and perf profiles for the new open models. Primary list: orca-13b, mistral-7b, mosaic7b, llama-c, zephyr-2.1. @samir can you confirm owners for the first two? @legal / @licensing-bot we need any red flags asap.

samir: I can own orca-13b and mistral-7b perf runs. Will pick up profiling this week. Does someone own mosaic7b by chance?

jordan: mosaic7b is on me. Quick note: intake had mixed dataset licenses flagged. I need legal to confirm whether CC-BY-NC blocks hosted serving. @elena any intake context?

elena: intake notes attached — mosaic7b pulled from multiple sources, some CC variants. I already filed LEG-3412 for legal review. @licensing-bot can you dump current status?

licensing-bot: LICENSING-BOT: Ticket LEG-3412 created by elena. Current status: awaiting legal review. Alerts detected: potential CC-BY-NC content. Recommendation: do-not-serve commercially until clearance.

frank: perf update: quantized default profile for orca-13b on A100-80GB showing ~18% throughput regression vs baseline (token/s). I've got a patch in PR #4923. Also seeing higher mem frag on long context.

samir: noted — will review PR. If we can't reach perf SLOs, let's consider shipping a non-quantized variant as the "default" for v1 and mark quantized as experimental in the catalog. Example profile I'm testing: ```json
{"model":"orca-13b","profile":"default-v1","quantize":"int8","max_seq":2048,"batching":{"max_tokens":4096}}
```

mia: ownership map (for launch doc): orca-13b -> samir; mistral-7b -> samir; mosaic7b -> jordan; llama-c -> elena; zephyr-2.1 -> frank. Please confirm or call out missing models.

jordan: add zephyr-2.1 — infra imported it last week but nobody claimed ownership. I don't own it. Who handled the intake?

elena: intake was by frank — frank_s on the intake ticket.

frank: confirmed, zephyr-2.1 intake done. License = Apache-2.0. Perf buckets green but failing summarization eval S1 (recall dip). Investigating eval config and prompt set.

mia: action items for next steps: 1) legal to clear LEG-3412 or provide restriction language; 2) samir finish PR and upload perf profiles/artifacts; 3) frank fix S1 eval or add explicit caveat on the model page; 4) jordan confirm model metadata fields for catalog (description, tags, default config, restrictions). Any volunteers for docs 1-pagers?

jordan: quick infra note — @deploy-bot ran catalog staging ingest yesterday and hit a metadata ingest timeout: "ERROR: 504 upstream read timeout" at 14:23 UTC. Might be related to large model manifest sizes.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY-BOT: staged ingest retry scheduled (3 attempts). Last attempt: queued. Will report status to this thread when finished.

elena: for launch comms we need 1-pager per model: owner, recommended profile, known caveats/licenses, perf numbers (p95 latency, token/s), and eval highlights. @docs-team please pick this up if possible.

samir: will attach perf CSVs and flamegraphs to PR and drop links here once CI finishes. :thumbsup:

mia: thanks all — I'll consolidate these into a launch checklist and post by EOD. If legal can't clear mosaic7b in time, fallback plan: ship version 1 without mosaic7b and schedule a follow-up release once cleared. Ping me for anything blocking.
